title: REQ · Admin round routes mounted and scheduler started in the server
summary: server.New mounts admin round routes behind token auth and exposes the scheduler
description: Context: server.New mounts only execution routes under /api/v1/admin. Desired: also mount POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions using round.Service built from round.FileStore, gitCLI and contribution store; main starts round.Scheduler with cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval.
acceptance_criteria: Given admin token tok, when each of the five round endpoints is requested with Bearer tok, then status is not 404
Given no Authorization header, when a round endpoint is requested, then status is 401
Given cfg.Round.SchedulerInterval, when the scheduler is built, then its Interval equals that value and Worlds lists world IDs from world.Repo
non_functional: Scheduler stops when the process context is cancelled
